user_story: As a user, I want my password reset token to be invalidated after use so that it cannot be reused.

positive.title: Password reset token is invalidated after successful use
steps: Request a password reset token via the 'Forgot Password' feature.
Use the received reset token to reset the password.
positive.expected_result: The password is reset successfully, and the token is invalidated.

negative.title: Attempt to reuse an expired password reset token
steps: Request a password reset token via the 'Forgot Password' feature.
Use the received reset token to reset the password successfully.
Attempt to use the same token again to reset the password.
negative.expected_result: The password reset fails, indicating the token is invalid or expired.

edge.title: Immediate use of a very recently expired password reset token
steps: Request a password reset token via the 'Forgot Password' feature.
Wait for just past the token expiration time.
Use the expired token to attempt to reset the password.
edge.expected_result: The password reset fails, showing that the token is expired.
